effective_agents.name: flight_search_assistant
effective_agents.binding: ADK LlmAgent directly bound to a local stdio MCPToolset

expected_claims.statement: The agent is source-bound to a local stdio MCP tool catalogue without an explicit source-visible tool allowlist.
qualifications: The reviewed repo does not prove the complete remote/package tool catalogue.
evidence: client.py: MCPToolset with StdioServerParameters and tools=[toolset]

negative_controls.statement: Starting the MCP server command must not be treated as model-callable process execution.
SERP_API_KEY passed in MCP process environment must not be represented as a model-callable secrets.read capability.
No arbitrary remote MCP network destination should be claimed from a fixed local stdio connection.

coverage_notes: The source proves agent-to-MCP binding but not the package-internal flight-search tool implementations.
